_comment: The single copy of every pin for the bundled evaluator. Read by
a second copy anywhere is the two-texts-drift failure.
jar_sha256 was measured 2026-08-30 from the GitHub v4.1.0 release
artifact itself (size matches the release listing, 53,251,383 bytes).
It is NOT byte-identical to the jar inside the winget msi (200 bytes
smaller, a separate CI rebuild of the same version), so byte identity
with the installed launcher is unavailable; the two are instead proven
to produce identical truth tables by tests/test_desktop_bundle.py.
modules were read from that image's runtime/release file -- the
vendor's own measured module set, not our guess.
Logisim Evolution is GPL-3.0; bundling it in the installer is
redistribution the license permits, with source at jar_url's repo.
